title: MSFS 2024 Helicopter Control Settings & WinWing Ursa Minor Configuration
description:
Master helicopter flight in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (MSFS) as we configure the WinWing Ursa Minor/WinCtrl Ursa Minor joystick for precision control! Whether you are flying the Cabri G2 or the H125, setting up dedicated helicopter profiles is essential for handling these high-performance machines.

In this tutorial, we break down the essentials: creating dedicated control profiles, mapping the Cyclic, Collective, and Rudder axis, and assigning must-have buttons for a seamless experience. We also dive into specific H125 mappings for cargo and hoist operations to get you mission-ready.

Stay tuned until the end to see how you can import my personal configuration files to save yourself the setup time!

📖 Chapters
In this video, we cover:

0:00 - intro
00:46 - General Controls vs Airplane Controls: Which profile to use?
02:11 - Understanding MSFS 2024 profile rypes
03:27 - Essential Axis: cyclic, rudder & collective
06:40 - Best camera mappings (Top Hat)
08:19 - Must-Have: force trim & reset trim
09:30 - Mapping the WinWing/WinCtrl Ursa Minor Base Buttons
16:38 - How to import my config files
